{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nColumns:")
print(df.dtypes)

print("\nMissing values (nulls):")
print(df.isnull().sum())

print("\nUnique patient_id count:")
print(df['patient_id'].nunique())

print("\nDuplicate patient_id count:")
print((df['patient_id'].duplicated()).sum())

print("\nSample_seq distribution:")
print(df['sample_seq'].value_counts().sort_index())

print("\nbiomarker_baseline -999 count:")
print((df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

print("\nassay_batch values:")
print(df['assay_batch'].value_counts())"}
